notes: Remake rules for repairing and capturing base objects (generators, turrets, sensors, stations). The originals only disable an object at its disabled damage (Tribes 1 StaticShape::onDamage / Tribes 2 GameBase disabled damage state) and the repair pack brings it back (base_equipment.json 'repair': T1 RepairBolt, T2 repairpack.cs RepairGunImage); the capture-by-repairing rule and the faction repair crew are remake design values.

capture.text: A soldier whose repair work touches an object of a team that is not allied to him takes it for this long (or until it is destroyed or its owner repairs it back); then it returns to its owner.

faction_repair.text: A guard soldier of a faction walks to the nearest damaged or downed object of its own side (generators first, one soldier per object) and repairs it at the pack's object repair rate.
